tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: bla sgrub rtsa ba tshig rkang bdun: 'don thabs pad+ma drwa ba bzhugs: :

rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs lha la 'dud: rang byung rdo rje'i tshig bdun po: bla sgrub kun gyi rtsa ba ste: 'di nyid kho nas mchog thun gyi: dngos grub sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa: dad mos dam tshig ldan pa pos: rtsa ba'i rnal 'byor thod phreng rtsal: yang na yi dam gang 'dod bskyed: gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'od zer gyis: so so'i zhing nas spyan drangs thim: dngos grub thogs med 'grub par mos: thog mar bla ma sku gsum la: brten nas ye shes gsum skyed pa'i: tshig sngags kha bsgyur 'di ltar ro: hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: kun tu 'chang gi rnam par byon: gzhi snang 'khrul pa dbyings su sol: ka dag gzhi thog phebs pa dang: chos sku'i dgongs pa mngon gyur mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru badz+ra dhā ra hūm̐: de ltar tshig bdun 'gres sbyar te: tshe dpag med pa'i rnam par byon: 'chi bdag bdud bzhi dbyings su sol: lhun grub rig rtsal rgyas pa dang: longs sku'i bkod pa brnyes par mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī ban+ti ye swā hāḥ mtsho skyes rdo rje'i rnam par byon: gnyis snang bag chags dbyings su sol: 'chi med 'ja' lus thob pa dang: sprul sku'i 'gro don mthar phyin mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: bla ma sku bzhi la bsten nas: dbang bzhi'i byin rlabs 'beb pa ni: tshig bdun sham bu 'di ltar bsgyur: thod phreng rtsal gyi rnam par byon: lus la bum pa'i dbang mchog skur: rtsa yi sgrib dag lha ru smin: snang stong sprul skur 'grub par mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐:

thugs rje chen po'i rnam par byon: ngag la gsang ba'i dbang mchog skur: rlung gi sgrib dag sngags su smin: grags stong longs skur 'grub par mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ.oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: 'od dpag med kyi rnam par byon: yid la thugs kyi dbang mchog skur: thig le'i sgrib dag ye shes smin: rig stong chos skur 'grub par mdzod: oṃ a mi dhe ba hrī: pad+ma badz+ra'i rnam par byon: dbyer med rig rtsal dbang mchog skur: bag chags sgrib dag bde chen smin: ngo bo nyid skur 'grub par mdzod: oṃ pad+ma badz+ra hūm̐: thod phreng sde lnga la bsten nas: dug lnga phung lnga sbyang ba ni: rdo rje'i tshig rkang bdun gyi mthar: bud+dha thod phreng rnam par byon: gti mug chos kyi dbyings su sbyongs: gzugs kyi phung po gnas sgyur la: 'gyur med sku ru byin gyis rlobs: oṃ gu ru bud+dha thod phreng rtsal bai ro tsa na sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: pad+ma thod phreng rnam par byon: 'dod chags sor rtog ngang du sbyongs: 'du shes phung po gnas sgyur la: 'gag med gsung du byin gyis rlobs: āḥgu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal a mi ta bhā sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: badz+ra thod phreng rnam par byon: zhe sdang me long lta bur sbyongs: rnam shes phung po gnas sgyur la: 'khrul med thugs su byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐ gu ru badz+ra thod phreng rtsal badz+ra ak+ṣo bh+ya sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: rat+na thod phreng rnam par byon: nga rgyal mnyam pa nyid du sbyongs: tshor ba'i phung po gnas sgyur la: yon tan rtsol med byin gyis rlobs: swā gu ru rat+na thod phreng rtsal rat+na saṃ bha ba sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: karma thod phreng rnam par byon: phrag dog bya grub chen por sbyongs: 'du byed phung po gnas sgyur la: phrin las thogs med byin gyis rlobs: hā gu ru karma thod phreng rtsal a mo gha sid+dhi sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: rigs drug gu ru la bsten nas:

'gro drug skye sgo bcad pa ni: tshig bdun gsham du sngags tshig bsgyur: srid thub 'dzin gyi rnam par byon: nga rgyal rgyu 'bras rtsad nas chod: 'pho ltung lha yi gnas stongs nas: dpal ldan zhing du byin gyis rlobs: oṃ rat+na gu ru de ba ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da hūm̐ phaṭa: rnam rgyal gu ru'i rnam par byon: phrag dog rgyu 'bras rtsad nas chod: lha min 'thab rtsod gnas stongs nas: las rab rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs: oṃ karma gu ru a su rā traṭa traṭa hūm̐ phaṭa: pad+ma gu ru'i rnam par byon: 'dod chags rgyu 'bras rtsad nas chod: brel phongs mi yi gnas stongs nas: pad+mo bkod par byin gyis rlobs: oṃ ma hā gu ru nṛ bṛ ta bṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa: seng ge rab brtan rnam par byon: gti mug rgyu 'bras rtsad nas chod: glen lkugs dud 'gro'i gnas stongs nas: stug po bkod du byin gyis rlobs: oṃ bud+dha gu ru tir+ya ka ma tha ma tha hūm̐ phaṭa: rnam snang gu ru'i rnam par byon: ser sna'i rgyu 'bras rtsad nas chod: bkres skom yi dwags gnas stongs nas: bde ba can du byin gyis rlobs: oṃ pad+ma gu ru pre ta ka pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa: rnam gnon gu ru'i rnam par byon: zhe sdang rgyu 'bras rtsad nas chod: tsha grang dmyal ba'i gnas stongs nas: mngon dga'i zhing du byin gyis rlobs: oṃ badz+ra gu ru na ra ka da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa: rabs bdun gu ru la bsten nas: dkor bdun don dam rtsal rdzogs phyir: sham bu 'di ltar gdags par bya: bde skyong rdo rje'i rnam par byon: yongs 'dzin phyi yi dbang bskur stsol: mtshan dpe'i sku yi rang rtsal rdzogs: rdo rje rtag par byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma kā ya sid+dhi hūm̐: zag med 'od gsal rnam par byon: gsang gsum nang gi dbang bskur stsol: tshangs dbyangs gsung gi rang rtsal rdzogs: gar gyi dbang por byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma wā ka sid+dhi hūm̐:

'dul skyong chen po'i rnam par byon: glegs bam sgrub pa'i dbang bskur stsol: 'od gsal thugs kyi rang rtsal rdzogs: rdo rje sems dpar byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: ting 'dzin 'chang ba'i rnam par byon: byang sems gsang ba'i dbang bskur stsol: 'dod 'byung yon tan rang rtsal rdzogs: rdo rje nyi mar byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma gu ṇa sid+dhi hūm̐: yon tan blo ldan rnam par byon: shes rab phyag rgya'i dbang bskur stsol: 'gro 'dul phrin las rang rtsal rdzogs: rta mchog rgyal por byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma karma sid+dhi hūm̐: thabs shes dbyings sbyor rnam par byon: ka dag rig rtsal dbang bskur stsol: dbyings kyi don dam rang rtsal rdzogs: he ru ka dpal byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma dhā tu sid+dhi hūm̐: slob dpon pad+ma'i rnam par byon: lhun grub 'od gsal dbang bskur stsol: ye shes don dam rang rtsal rdzogs: 'od mi 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma dzñā na sid+dhi hūm̐: mtshan brgyad gtso dgu la bsten nas: theg pa rim dgu'i lam bgrod phyir: tshig sngags kha bsgyur 'di ltar sbyor: shākya seng ge'i rnam par byon: tshangs spyod rnam dag dbang mchog skur: bden bzhi'i don rtogs nyan thos kyi: bslab gsum yongs rdzogs dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥbadz+ra gu ru shākya siṃ ha sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: blo ldan mchog sred rnam par byon: rang byung khrims rdzogs dbang mchog skur: rten 'brel don gnas rang rgyal gyi: lta sgom rtogs pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥbadz+ra gu ru pra dzñā dzñā na sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: pad+ma rgyal po'i rnam par byon: byang chub spyod pa'i dbang mchog skur: tshul khrims gsum ldan byang sems kyi: sa lam mthar phyin dngos grub stsol:

oṃ āḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma rā dza sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: pad+ma saṃ bha'i rnam par byon: spang rtogs rdzogs pa'i dbang mchog skur: spyod pa gtso ston kri ya pa'i: rnal 'byor mchog thob dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma saṃ bha ba sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: nyi ma 'od zer rnam par byon: sgrib sel nus thob dbang mchog skur: lta spyod gnyis ldan u bha ya'i: ting 'dzin rtsal rdzogs dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥbadz+ra gu ru sūr+ya rasmi sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: seng ge sgra sgrog rnam par byon: phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang mchog skur: phyag rgya bzhi ldan yo ga pa'i: bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥbadz+ra gu ru siṃ ha gaṇ+ḍe sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: rdo rje gro lod rnam par byon: sgo gsum smin byed dbang bzhi skur: ma hā dkyil 'khor gsum ldan gyi: rim gnyis grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥbadz+ra gu ru badz+ra gro bo lod sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: pad+ma 'byung gnas rnam par byon: phyi nang sgrub gsang dbang bzhi skur: a nu dbyings ye gnyis med ngang: lam 'bras 'byongs pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+mā ka ra sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: yid bzhin nor bu'i rnam par byon: dgongs pa don gyi dbang bzhi skur: a ti chos can chos nyid dbyings: zad sar 'khyol ba'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥbadz+ra gu ru ts+tshin+da ma ṇi sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: 'di kun shin tu zab pa'i phul: ye shes gcig sbyor ting 'dzin te: spros la dga' ba'i rnal 'byor pas: gu ru so so'i mngon rtogs bsgom: phrin las rim pa'i sgrom du gzhug: 'phro 'du'i dmigs pa gsal ba'i ngang: tshig bdun dang ni bzlas par 'bad: byin rlabs rtags mtshan dngos su 'ong: yid gnyis the tshom med par gces: sa ma ya: gzhan yang 'phrul mtshan bzhi bcu dang: sngags kyi ston pa bcu phrag lnga: mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa: re re bzhin du kha bsgyur na:

'dod don ma lus sgrub pa la: yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal po bzhin: mdor bsdus mtshan mchog spyi bsdoms dang: nyer mkho'i sham bu 'di ltar spel: hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi nas/ gshegs su gsol: 'phrul mtshan bzhi bcu'i rnam par byon: smin grol mthar phyin dbang mchog skur: gzung 'dzin 'khrul rtog dbyings su sol: las dang ye shes dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: ston pa lnga bcu'i rnam par byon: ye shes gcig sbyor dbang mchog skur: sgrib gnyis bag chags dbyings su sol: sku lnga lhun grub dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad rnam par byon: lha sngags rig pa'i dbang mchog skur: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: don gnyis mthar phyin dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal dzñā na ḍā ki nī badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ ā: tshe dbang rig 'dzin rnam par byon: 'chi med tshe yi dbang mchog skur: tshe bdud bar chad zhi bar mdzod: skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dza: gu ru che mchog rnam par byon: mthu rtsal stobs kyi dbang mchog skur: dmag dpung zlog cing 'thab rtsod zhi: rgyal khams bde ba'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra gu ru ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: gu ru sman bla'i rnam par byon: bdud rtsi 'od zer dbang mchog skur: dug gsum nad gdon rtsad nas choms: bde skyid dpal gyi dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru bai ḍūr+ya bhai ṣa dz+ye bhai ṣa dz+ye ma hā bhai ṣa dz+ye rā dza sa muṅga te swā hā: gu ru nor lha'i rnam par byon: rat+na gter gyi dbang mchog skur: dbul phongs bkres skom sdug bsngal sol: dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye dha na me dhi hrīḥswā hā:

'byung bzhi dbang sgyur rnam par byon: gzhom med nam mkha'i dbang mchog skur: sa chu me rlung 'jigs pa zhi: rang dbang sgyur ba'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra gu ru yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ sarba bha ya shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: zil gnon drag po'i rnam par byon: byin rlabs rtsal gyi dbang mchog skur: gnas zhal gter sgo 'byed pa dang: lung bstan thob pa'i dngos grub stsol: hūm̐ a ka ma: ha a ra ya: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na trig nan sbur thuṃ dzaḥdza: dha lo sha pu wa ma a nṛ tri sid+dhi pha la dzaḥdza: rdo rje drag rtsal rnam par byon: rig rtsal thogs med dbang mchog skur: snang grags lha dang sngags su rdzogs: chos nyid gding thob dngos grub stsol: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dmar nag me phreng rnam par byon: gdug pa 'dul ba'i dbang mchog skur: khams gsum zil gyis gnon pa dang: srid gsum dbang sdud dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ.artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga ba te hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: badz+ra hūm̐: yak+sha hūm̐: rak+sha hūm̐: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa: rdo rje chos kyi rnam par byon: gsang chen lung gi dbang mchog skur: rgyud lung man ngag mdzod brnyes shing: gsang ba 'dzin pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru badz+ra dharma gu h+ya sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: bde ba chen po'i rnam par byon: lhan skyes dga' bzhi'i dbang mchog skur: rdo rje'i gsang lam bgrod pa dang: bde chen 'gyur med dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru ma hā su kha sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: 'od mi 'gyur ba'i rnam par byon: ye shes rig pa'i dbang mchog skur: tha snyad blo las 'das pa'i ngang: rtogs grol dus mnyam dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru sa man+ta bha dra sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: de ltar mtshan dang rnam pa'i tshul: tha dad bsgyur bas gang 'dod don: bde blag nyid du byed pa ste: dper na nor bu gcig nyid la: gsol ba gang btab 'grub dang mtshungs:

mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun: 'di nyid kho nas 'grub par nges: brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs: so so'i byin rlabs bskul 'dod na: gtso bo rdo rje slob dpon gyi: ye shes klong du ro gcig phyir: ngo bo gu ru pad+ma 'byung: rnam pa de dang der gsal nas: kun la tshig bdun sham bu bsgyur: rang rang skul 'dzab gzhung bzhin sbyar: dgongs brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs thob: brda brgyud rig pa'i rtsal chen 'byongs: snyan brgyud bka' lung man ngag dbang: phrin las gang brtsam lhun grub 'gyur: sa ma ya: bdag nyid pad+ma kun tu 'chang: gdod ma'i dbyings su snyoms zhugs tshe: chos nyid rang rtsal rdo rje'i sgra: tshig bdun rang byung dbyangs kyis bskul: longs sku gzi brjid dpag med bzhengs: mkha' khyab nges pa lnga ldan gyi: zhing dang sku yi bkod pa bstan: de tshe dbyings kyi yum lnga yis: 'gro don tshig bdun glu yis bskul: bde chen zhing du 'o ma'i mtshor: pad sdong rtse la skur bzhengs pa: thod phreng sde lnga zhes su grags: rnam thar mdzad pa bsam las 'das: slar yang ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: bye ba phrag brgyas mgrin gcig tu: dzaṃ gling shākya'i gdul zhing du: gsang sngags bstan pa spel ba'i ched: tshig bdun dbyangs kyis spyan drangs pas: sngags kyi 'byung gnas o rgyan yul: dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du: ngo mtshar pad+ma'i sdong po'i rtser: bde can zhing nas sprul skur byon: mtsho skyes rdo rje zhes su grags: bsam mi khyab pa'i cho 'phrul bstan: ya mtshan bkod pa tshad las 'das: mtsho gling dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mar: gsang chen gsang ba'i yang snying ni: pad+ma sgyu 'phrul drwa ba yi: rgyud lung man ngag bye phrag brgya: gdul bya'i bsam pa tha dad pa: byung dang 'byung 'gyur don phyir gsungs: kun kyang rtsa gsum gcig 'dus dngos: bdag nyid gu ru sgrub pa'i thabs: de kun rtsa ba tshig bdun pa: gzhi yi rnam shes tshogs bdun po:

lam dus byang chub yan lag bdun: don dam dkor bdun 'bras bur rdzogs: de ltar rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs 'dis: bskul ba tsam gyis pad+ma bdag: dbang med byon nas byin gyis rlob: ye shes chen po'i dbang skur bstsal: rtsa gsum lha tshogs sprin bzhin 'du: dngos grub rnam gnyis thogs med ster: dngos nyams rmi lam nga dang mjal: 'ja' 'od 'khyil zhing dri bzang 'thul: brda dbyangs cang te'u'i sgra skad thos: lus ngag yid la byin chen phebs: rig rtsal thod rgal rtogs pa skye: sde brgyad dregs par bka' btsan zhing: 'brel tshad don ldan byin nus thob: myur du rig 'dzin sar gshegs nas: pad+ma bdag dang dbyer med 'gyur: sa ma ya: bdag nyid rtsa ba gsum gyi dngos: mtsho las skyes pa'i rdo rje'i sku: sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i tshul 'chang bas: mos pa dang mtshungs gsol btab na: de dang mthun pa'i dngos grub ster: de phyir da lta'i rje 'bangs dang: phyi rabs gdul bya'i don ched du: thugs kyi bcud phyungs brtse bas gdams: ma spel zab mo'i gter du sbos: snyigs dus kho bo'i gdul bya 'byung: de tshe bai ro'i smon lam mthus: 'od gsal brda yi ri mor shar: blo ldan zhig gis 'dul thabs ston: 'gro phan mtha' ru rgyas par 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: :
